confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough. Sources are crowd-sourced, some are dated (2012 to 2021), and they convert JMD to USD inconsistently. No Ocho Rios menus were checked, and it is unclear whether the 15% GCT, 10% service charge and tips are included. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates; no live listings were inspected. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local beer relationship because direct evidence is weak. The FX value comes from search-result summaries that reproduce the RBA table for 2026-11-18. The rba.gov.au page was not opened directly, and no RBA observation for 2026-11-19 was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct Ocho Rios price index was found. The basis is Jamaican north-coast resort pricing, using Montego Bay and Negril reference points, adjusted upward for Ocho Rios as a tourist hub. Jamaica is grouped under Latin America and the Caribbean.
